external_primary.finding: On one connection, data_version changes when any other connection commits changes to the database; same-connection commits do not change it; values are connection-local and are meaningful only when compared on the same connection over time.

counterhypothesis.statement: A hard PRAGMA main.data_version fence may reject legitimate unrelated commits by other components sharing canonical UnifiedDB, because the witness is database-wide rather than WP206-table-specific.
counterhypothesis.discriminator: With the G6 fence active, commit only to an explicitly non-WP206 table from a second legitimate connection and then invoke the original WP206 store guard. If it raises external revision drift, G6 is an exclusive-database-writer fence and requires either an explicit exclusive writer-epoch contract or a narrower owned-state revision witness before acceptance.
